bio_en: Arshak Torlakian was born in September 1879 in the village of Apion, finished the village school and worked the land, loved by family and neighbours. In 1904-05 he joined the ARF's terror group under the name Beko to fight the tyranny of the Turkish beys and aghas who seized Armenian homes and drove Armenians to emigrate to the Black Sea coast of Russia. With his comrade Abgar he later devoted himself to public work, serving as church and school trustee and finally as head of the village. He was killed by a criminal's bullet in September 1910.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Location of Apion not stated in the portion read; the author is his relative (a Torlakian) - region Trabzon assumed by analogy with Galust Torlakian (#356); verify.
